items.title: Strategy Sets New BTC Holdings Record After $143M Bitcoin Purchase
items.summary: Michael Saylor's Bitcoin treasury firm bought 1,665 BTC last week, taking its holdings above its previous record to 847,666 BTC.

items.title: Morning Minute: SEC Clears Token Buybacks for Crypto Networks
